name: Echo Fire
description: Shots have a 30% chance to fire a free automatic second shot right after (it uses no ammo).
details: The echo shot is a full copy of your shot (same bullets, effects and damage) a moment later. It's free: it uses no ammo and still fires if the shot before it emptied your mag. It doesn't trigger more echoes. Copies stack: every full point is a guaranteed echo.
